records.context: **Geometric units depend on the run.** A 2-D run measures in pixels, but a 3-D run measures a volume, and with ``voxel_size_z_um`` / ``voxel_size_xy_um`` set it measures in micrometres — under the *same* column names, because :mod:`spacr.measure` deliberately does not rename ``<object>_area`` (renaming would break every downstream selector). Which one a row is in is recorded on the row itself, in ``measurement_units``. So the unit of a geometric column is a :class:`ConditionalUnit`: :func:`describe_database` reads ``measurement_units`` out of the database it is documenting and resolves it, and a caller who has no database says so and gets the condition spelled out instead of a confident guess. See :data:`MEASUREMENT_UNITS`.
records.label: spacr.feature_dict#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Geometric units depend on the run.** A 2-D run measures in pixels, but a 3-D run measures a volume, and with ``voxel_size_z_um`` / ``voxel_size_xy_um`` set it measures in micrometres — under the *same* column names, because :mod:`spacr.measure` deliberately does not rename ``<object>_area`` (renaming would break every downstream selector). Which one a row is in is recorded on the row itself, in ``measurement_units``. So the unit of a geometric column is a :class:`ConditionalUnit`: :func:`describe_database` reads ``measurement_units`` out of the database it is documenting and resolves it, and a caller who has no database says so and gets the condition spelled out instead of a confident guess. See :data:`MEASUREMENT_UNITS`.
records.translation: **几何单位取决于运行。**2-D 运行以像素为单位测量，但 3-D 运行测量的是体积，并且在设置了 ``voxel_size_z_um`` / ``voxel_size_xy_um`` 时以微米为单位——而列名*相同*，因为 :mod:`spacr.measure` 有意不重命名 ``<object>_area``（重命名会破坏下游的每个选择器）。某一行采用哪种单位记录在该行本身的 ``measurement_units`` 中。因此，几何列的单位是一个 :class:`ConditionalUnit`：:func:`describe_database` 会从其所描述的数据库中读取 ``measurement_units`` 并加以解析，而没有数据库的调用方会如实说明这一点，并得到完整写出的条件，而不是一个自信的猜测。参见 :data:`MEASUREMENT_UNITS`。

records.context: The script serves three purposes, and the third is why it also carries a data structure:
records.label: spacr.macro#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The script serves three purposes, and the third is why it also carries a data structure:
records.translation: 该脚本有三个用途，而第三个用途正是它还携带一个数据结构的原因：

records.context: **A reproducibility record.** The script is the method section. Its header carries the spaCR version, the processing-session id and the settings hash. The processing-session id is the id :mod:`spacr.runctx` stamped on every log line the processing session emitted and :mod:`spacr.artifacts` stamped on every output it registered, so the script, the log and the files all join on one column. The settings hash is :func:`spacr.artifacts.settings_hash`, the same digest the artifact rows carry.
records.label: spacr.macro#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **A reproducibility record.** The script is the method section. Its header carries the spaCR version, the run id and the settings hash. The run id is the id :mod:`spacr.runctx` stamped on every log line the run emitted and :mod:`spacr.artifacts` stamped on every output it registered, so the script, the log and the files all join on one column. The settings hash is :func:`spacr.artifacts.settings_hash`, the same digest the artifact rows carry.
records.translation: **可复现性记录。**该脚本就是方法部分。其文件头带有 spaCR 版本、运行 ID 和设置哈希。运行 ID 就是 :mod:`spacr.runctx` 在该运行输出的每一行日志上所标记的 ID，也是 :mod:`spacr.artifacts` 在其注册的每个输出上所标记的 ID，因此脚本、日志和文件都可以通过同一列进行连接。设置哈希是 :func:`spacr.artifacts.settings_hash`，即产物行所携带的同一个摘要。

records.context: **A starting point for the Python API.** ``macro.py`` holds the code a user would write by hand — the import and the entry-point call — rather than a wrapper or a replay harness.
records.label: spacr.macro#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **A starting point for the Python API.** ``macro.py`` holds the code a user would write by hand — the import and the entry-point call — rather than a wrapper or a replay harness.
records.translation: **Python API 的起点。**``macro.py`` 保存的是用户会手工编写的代码——导入语句和入口点调用——而不是封装器或回放框架。

records.context: **Most of the input to the methods-and-results exporter.** Which is why the script also carries :data:`MACRO`, a plain key-value mapping literal holding every step's module, entry point, processing-session id, settings, which of those settings were merely defaults, what it produced and how long it took. :func:`read_macro` reads it back *without executing the script* — it is parsed, not imported — so the exporter can consume a macro it did not generate and does not trust.
records.label: spacr.macro#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Most of the input to the methods-and-results exporter.** Which is why the script also carries :data:`MACRO`, a plain dict literal holding every step's module, entry point, run id, settings, which of those settings were merely defaults, what it produced and how long it took. :func:`read_macro` reads it back *without executing the script* — it is parsed, not imported — so the exporter can consume a macro it did not generate and does not trust.
records.translation: **方法与结果导出器的大部分输入。**这就是脚本还携带 :data:`MACRO` 的原因：这是一个普通的字典字面量，保存每个步骤的模块、入口点、运行 ID、设置、其中哪些设置只是默认值、产出了什么以及耗时多久。:func:`read_macro` 会*在不执行脚本的情况下*将其读回——它被解析而不是被导入——因此导出器可以使用一个并非由其生成、也不受其信任的宏。

records.context: Properties of the emitted script
records.label: spacr.macro#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Properties of the emitted script
records.translation: 所生成脚本的特性

records.context: *Defaults are written out.* A settings key-value mapping that omits ``cell_diameter`` runs with whatever spaCR's default is **today**. Pin the version and that is reproducible; anything less is not. So every field name in the module's defaults is emitted with its value, and :data:`MACRO` records which structured-data names that the user actually set (``user_set``) and which were filled in (``defaulted``) — the exporter needs that distinction and the script must not lose it.
records.label: spacr.macro#8
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: *Defaults are written out.* A settings dict that omits ``cell_diameter`` runs with whatever spaCR's default is **today**. Pin the version and that is reproducible; anything less is not. So every key of the module's defaults is emitted with its value, and :data:`MACRO` records which keys the user actually set (``user_set``) and which were filled in (``defaulted``) — the exporter needs that distinction and the script must not lose it.
records.translation: *默认值会被写出。*省略了 ``cell_diameter`` 的设置字典会以 spaCR **当天**的默认值运行。固定版本后这是可复现的；否则就不可复现。因此，模块默认值的每个键都会连同其值一起写出，并且 :data:`MACRO` 会记录哪些键是用户实际设置的（``user_set``）、哪些是被填入的（``defaulted``）——导出器需要这一区分，脚本不能丢失它。

records.context: *A chain is one script.* Mask, then Measure, then Classify on the same project is one file with three steps in dependency order, not three files. The edge is confirmed against :func:`spacr.ports.next_modules`, so the order in the script is the order the workflow contract declares.
records.label: spacr.macro#9
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: *A chain is one script.* Mask, then Measure, then Classify on the same project is one file with three steps in dependency order, not three files. The edge is confirmed against :func:`spacr.ports.next_modules`, so the order in the script is the order the pipeline contract declares.
records.translation: *一条链就是一个脚本。*在同一个项目上依次运行 Mask、Measure 和 Classify，会得到一个按依赖顺序包含三个步骤的文件，而不是三个文件。这条边会与 :func:`spacr.ports.next_modules` 进行核对，因此脚本中的顺序就是流程约定所声明的顺序。

records.context: A chain grows while consecutive runs stay connected — the next module consumes what the previous one produced, on the same project. A processing session that connects to nothing starts a new :class:`Macro`, because a script that welds two unrelated plates together is not a reproduction of either.
records.label: spacr.macro.Macro#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A chain grows while consecutive runs stay connected — the next module consumes what the previous one produced, on the same project. A run that connects to nothing starts a new :class:`Macro`, because a script that welds two unrelated plates together is not a reproduction of either.
records.translation: 只要连续的运行保持关联——下一个模块消费上一个模块在同一项目上的产出——链就会不断增长。与任何内容都没有关联的运行会开始一个新的 :class:`Macro`，因为一个把两块不相关的板焊接在一起的脚本不能复现其中任何一块。

records.context: ``"registered"`` :func:`spacr.settings.defaults_for`, the ``register_defaults`` seam. ``"plugin"`` a plugin app's ``defaults`` factory. ``"settings_model"`` :func:`spacr.qt.screens.settings_model.resolve_default_settings`, the built-in dispatch. Guarded: it imports Qt, which a headless run does not have, and a missing Qt must cost the script its default-filling, never the script. ``"none"`` nothing answered. records.label: spacr.macro.module_defaults#2

records.source: ``"registered"`` :func:`spacr.settings.defaults_for`, the ``register_defaults`` seam. ``"plugin"`` a plugin app's ``defaults`` factory. ``"settings_model"`` :func:`spacr.qt.screens.settings_model.resolve_default_settings`, the built-in dispatch. Guarded: it imports Qt, which a headless run does not have, and a missing Qt must cost the script its default-filling, never the script. ``"none"`` nothing answered. The settings the caller passed are still emitted in full; only the unset keys are missing, and :data:`MACRO` says so through ``defaults_source``.
records.translation: ``"registered"`` :func:`spacr.settings.defaults_for`，即 ``register_defaults`` 接口。``"plugin"`` 插件应用的 ``defaults`` 工厂函数。``"settings_model"`` :func:`spacr.qt.screens.settings_model.resolve_default_settings`，即内置的分派机制。带有保护：它会导入无头运行所没有的 Qt，而缺少 Qt 只能让脚本失去默认值填充，而绝不能让脚本本身失效。``"none"`` 没有任何来源给出答案。调用方传入的设置仍会被完整写出；只有未设置的键会缺失，并且 :data:`MACRO` 会通过 ``defaults_source`` 说明这一点。

records.source: Parsed, never executed. The exporter's input is a file spaCR may not have written — someone else's macro, an edited one, one from a newer build — and importing it would run whatever is in it. So this walks the AST, evaluates the top-level literal assignments (which is how the ``PROJECT_1`` and ``*_SETTINGS`` names the metadata refers to are resolved) and returns the record.

records.context: The returned mask must equal the corrected layer exactly. The following rules apply, and each is covered by a test:
records.label: spacr.napari_bridge#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The returned mask must equal the corrected layer exactly. The following rules apply, and each is covered by a test:
records.translation: 返回的掩膜必须与修正后的图层完全相等。以下规则适用，并且每条规则都有测试覆盖：

records.context: **Label values survive exactly.** Label 41 comes back as 41 and not as 1, not renumbered, not relabelled by connectivity. :func:`to_spacr_mask` casts back to spaCR's ``uint16`` mask convention (:func:`spacr.mask_io.save_mask`) and **refuses** a label that would not fit rather than letting it wrap — ``np.uint16(70000)`` is ``4464`` without a warning, which would silently assign the cell a different label.
records.label: spacr.napari_bridge#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Label values survive exactly.** Label 41 comes back as 41 and not as 1, not renumbered, not relabelled by connectivity. :func:`to_spacr_mask` casts back to spaCR's ``uint16`` mask convention (:func:`spacr.mask_io.save_mask`) and **refuses** a label that would not fit rather than letting it wrap — ``np.uint16(70000)`` is ``4464`` without a warning, which would silently assign the cell a different label.
records.translation: **标签值精确保留。**标签 41 返回时仍为 41，而不是 1，不会被重新编号，也不会按连通性重新标记。:func:`to_spacr_mask` 会转换回 spaCR 的 ``uint16`` 掩膜约定（:func:`spacr.mask_io.save_mask`），并且对于放不下的标签会**拒绝**处理，而不是让它回绕——``np.uint16(70000)`` 会在没有任何警告的情况下变成 ``4464``，这会悄悄地给该细胞分配一个不同的标签。

records.context: **Orientation survives exactly.** A napari 2-D layer's array axes are ``(row, column)``, which is numpy's order and spaCR's order, so the correct amount of transposing is *none*. The test uses a non-square image, because a spurious ``.T`` is not detectable on a square one.
records.label: spacr.napari_bridge#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Orientation survives exactly.** A napari 2-D layer's array axes are ``(row, column)``, which is numpy's order and spaCR's order, so the correct amount of transposing is *none*. The test uses a non-square image, because a spurious ``.T`` is not detectable on a square one.
records.translation: **方向精确保留。**napari 2-D 图层的数组轴为 ``(row, column)``，这与 numpy 和 spaCR 的顺序相同，因此正确的转置量是*零*。测试使用非正方形图像，因为在正方形图像上无法检测出多余的 ``.T``。

records.context: **The shape may not change.** napari's brush cannot change an array's shape, but a caller handing back the wrong layer can, and that is a mistake worth a refusal rather than a resize.
records.label: spacr.napari_bridge#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The shape may not change.** napari's brush cannot change an array's shape, but a caller handing back the wrong layer can, and that is a mistake worth a refusal rather than a resize.
records.translation: **形状不得改变。**napari 的画笔无法改变数组的形状，但传回错误图层的调用方可以，而这是一个值得拒绝、而不是调整大小的错误。

records.source: Every write-back appends to the artefact's :class:`spacr.curation.CurationLog` — the same sidecar the brush writes, in the same append-only form. Without the record, a hand-edited mask could not be told apart from a segmented one. :func:`spacr.curation.is_curated` reports a napari correction the same way it reports a brush stroke.
records.translation: 每次写回都会追加到产物的 :class:`spacr.curation.CurationLog` 中——即画笔所写入的同一个旁车文件，采用同样的只追加形式。没有这份记录，就无法区分手工编辑过的掩膜与分割得到的掩膜。:func:`spacr.curation.is_curated` 报告 napari 修正的方式与报告画笔笔划的方式相同。

records.context: ADVI is an optimisation, not a sampler, and mean-field means the approximating family is a product of independent Gaussians in the unconstrained space.  Concretely:
records.label: spacr.power_model#15
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: ADVI is an optimisation, not a sampler, and mean-field means the approximating family is a product of independent Gaussians in the unconstrained space.  Concretely:
records.translation: ADVI 是一种优化方法，而不是采样器，而平均场意味着近似分布族是无约束空间中相互独立的高斯分布之积。具体而言：

records.context: 1. **Intervals are too narrow.** Mean-field VI systematically *underestimates* posterior variance, because it cannot represent posterior correlations and pays no penalty for ignoring them.  Treat ``q5``/``q95`` from the torch backend as a spread indicator, not as a calibrated 90 % interval, and never quote them as one in a paper. 2. **Convergence diagnostics are limited.** There is no R-hat and no effective sample size.  The only criterion is whether the ELBO stopped changing, which is reported as :attr:`PowerFit.converged` and is a much weaker claim than NUTS convergence. 3. **It can land in a local optimum**, and the horseshoe's funnel geometry is exactly the sort of thing that causes it. 4. **The posterior mean of beta — the ranking statistic — is the part that survives.** AUROC and average precision depend only on the *order* of the ``beta`` estimates, and that ordering is what mean-field VI gets right even when it gets the spread wrong.  This is why ADVI is a defensible default *for statistical detection sensitivity analysis specifically*, and why it is not a defensible default for reporting a per-gene credible interval.
records.label: spacr.power_model#16
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: 1. **Intervals are too narrow.** Mean-field VI systematically *underestimates* posterior variance, because it cannot represent posterior correlations and pays no penalty for ignoring them.  Treat ``q5``/``q95`` from the torch backend as a spread indicator, not as a calibrated 90 % interval, and never quote them as one in a paper. 2. **Convergence diagnostics are limited.** There is no R-hat and no effective sample size.  The only criterion is whether the ELBO stopped changing, which is reported as :attr:`PowerFit.converged` and is a much weaker claim than NUTS convergence. 3. **It can land in a local optimum**, and the horseshoe's funnel geometry is exactly the sort of thing that causes it. 4. **The posterior mean of beta — the ranking statistic — is the part that survives.** AUROC and average precision depend only on the *order* of the ``beta`` estimates, and that ordering is what mean-field VI gets right even when it gets the spread wrong.  This is why ADVI is a defensible default *for power analysis specifically*, and why it is not a defensible default for reporting a per-gene credible interval.
records.translation: 1. **区间过窄。**平均场 VI 会系统性地*低估*后验方差，因为它无法表示后验相关性，而忽略这些相关性也不会受到任何惩罚。请将 torch 后端给出的 ``q5``/``q95`` 视为离散程度的指示，而不是经过校准的 90 % 区间，并且绝不要在论文中将其作为这样的区间引用。2. **收敛诊断有限。**没有 R-hat，也没有有效样本量。唯一的标准是 ELBO 是否停止变化，它报告为 :attr:`PowerFit.converged`，这是一个比 NUTS 收敛弱得多的结论。3. **它可能陷入局部最优**，而 horseshoe 的漏斗形几何结构恰恰是导致这种情况的典型原因。4. **beta 的后验均值——即排名统计量——才是能够保留下来的部分。**AUROC 和平均精确率只取决于 ``beta`` 估计值的*顺序*，而即使平均场 VI 把离散程度弄错了，它也能把这一顺序弄对。这就是为什么 ADVI 是*专门用于功效分析*时站得住脚的默认选择，也是为什么它不是报告逐基因可信区间时站得住脚的默认选择。

records.source: **A gene with no across-well variance is not "not a hit".**  If a gene's ``log10expression`` column is constant, its coefficient is perfectly confounded with the intercept and the data carry no information about it. The horseshoe would shrink it to ~0, which reads like "tested, and not a hit", so those genes get ``NaN`` and are counted in ``n_unidentified_dropped`` instead.
records.translation: **在各孔之间没有方差的基因并不是 "not a hit"。**如果某个基因的 ``log10expression`` 列是常数，其系数就与截距完全混淆，而数据中不包含关于它的任何信息。horseshoe 会将其收缩到 ~0，这读起来就像 "tested, and not a hit"，因此这些基因会得到 ``NaN``，并改为计入 ``n_unidentified_dropped``。

records.source: One row per well.  ``Npositive`` positive cells out of ``Ntotal`` imaged, with a per-gene covariate ``log10expression`` — the log10 fraction of the well's sequencing reads assigned to that gene
records.translation: 每个孔一行。``Npositive`` 个阳性细胞，来自成像的 ``Ntotal`` 个细胞，并带有逐基因协变量 ``log10expression``——即该孔测序读数中分配给该基因的比例的 log10 值

records.context: Evidence score: *``beta_g``*. Higher values mean that wells carrying more of a gene have more positive cells than cell count alone explains. The relation ``p >> n`` means that genes greatly outnumber wells. Therefore *``beta``* uses a **regularized horseshoe prior** (Piironen & Vehtari, *Electron. J. Statist.* 11(2), 2017). Heavy tails preserve genuine hits, a sharp zero spike shrinks non-hits, and a Student-t slab keeps the tails proper.
records.label: spacr.power_model#8
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: ``beta_g`` is the evidence that gene *g* is a hit: higher means the wells carrying more of gene *g* had more positive cells than their cell count alone explains.  There are far more genes than wells (``p >> n``), so ``beta`` is given a **regularized horseshoe** prior (Piironen & Vehtari, *Electron. J. Statist.* 11(2), 2017) — heavy tails so genuine hits escape shrinkage, a sharp spike at zero so the hundreds of non-hits collapse onto it, and a Student-t slab so the tails stay proper.
records.translation: ``beta_g`` 是基因 *g* 为命中的证据：值越高，意味着携带更多基因 *g* 的孔中阳性细胞多于仅凭其细胞计数所能解释的数量。基因数远多于孔数（``p >> n``），因此 ``beta`` 采用**正则化 horseshoe** 先验（Piironen & Vehtari, *Electron. J. Statist.* 11(2), 2017）——重尾使真正的命中能够逃脱收缩，零处的尖峰使数以百计的非命中坍缩到零，而 Student-t slab 使尾部保持正常。

records.context: **Sign convention.**  The R computes ``mean_inv = -mean``, recodes ``hit`` as a factor with levels ``c("no", "yes")``, and hands both to ``yardstick``. ``yardstick``'s default ``event_level`` is ``"first"``, so the event it scores is ``"no"`` — the *non*-hits — and the score it scores them with is ``-mean``.  Scoring ``-m`` for the event "not a hit" is identical to scoring ``+m`` for the event "is a hit": both ROC curves are the same curve.  This port computes the equivalent ``roc_auc_score(y_true=hit, y_score=mean)``, and :func:`spacr.power_model.evaluate_model_fit`'s tests pin the orientation on a case whose answer is known — strong planted hits must score near 1, not near 0.  A flipped convention returns ``1 - AUROC``, which for a mediocre design is a plausible-looking value.
records.label: spacr.power_model.evaluate_model_fit#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Sign convention.**  The R computes ``mean_inv = -mean``, recodes ``hit`` as a factor with levels ``c("no", "yes")``, and hands both to ``yardstick``. ``yardstick``'s default ``event_level`` is ``"first"``, so the event it scores is ``"no"`` — the *non*-hits — and the score it scores them with is ``-mean``.  Scoring ``-m`` for the event "not a hit" is identical to scoring ``+m`` for the event "is a hit": both ROC curves are the same curve.  This port computes the equivalent ``roc_auc_score(y_true=hit, y_score=mean)``, and :func:`spacr.power_model.evaluate_model_fit`'s tests pin the orientation on a case whose answer is known — strong planted hits must score near 1, not near 0.  A flipped convention returns ``1 - AUROC``, which for a mediocre design is a plausible-looking value.
records.translation: **符号约定。**R 代码计算 ``mean_inv = -mean``，将 ``hit`` 重新编码为水平为 ``c("no", "yes")`` 的因子，并将两者交给 ``yardstick``。``yardstick`` 的默认 ``event_level`` 为 ``"first"``，因此它评分的事件是 ``"no"``——即*非*命中——而用于评分的分数是 ``-mean``。针对事件 "not a hit" 用 ``-m`` 评分，与针对事件 "is a hit" 用 ``+m`` 评分是完全相同的：两条 ROC 曲线是同一条曲线。本移植版计算等价的 ``roc_auc_score(y_true=hit, y_score=mean)``，而 :func:`spacr.power_model.evaluate_model_fit` 的测试在一个答案已知的情形上固定了方向——植入的强命中必须得分接近 1，而不是接近 0。翻转的约定会返回 ``1 - AUROC``，对于一个表现平平的设计来说，这是一个看似合理的值。

records.translation: 返回严格的 ``False`` 会停止扫描并返回迄今已完成的行；其他任何值（包括 ``None``）都会继续。这使 GUI 能够显示进度，并在不终止线程的情况下停止运行数分钟的扫描。单次拟合是原子的，因此取消会在当前拟合完成之后生效，而不是在拟合期间生效。回调在调用线程上内联运行，不得阻塞。回调抛出的异常会中止扫描，并传播给调用方。

records.context: **A point that fails is reported as failed.**  A fit that raises lands as ``status="failed"`` with the exception text in ``error``; a fit that executes but does not meet its convergence criterion lands as ``status="not_converged"``. records.source: **A point that fails is reported as failed.**  A fit that raises lands as ``status="failed"`` with the exception text in ``error``; a fit that runs but does not meet its convergence criterion lands as ``status="not_converged"``.  Both carry ``NaN`` metrics.  A sweep that filled in 0.5 for failed points would plot them as a design performing at chance, which would confuse "this design cannot find its hits" with "this fit failed".
records.translation: **失败的点会被报告为失败。**抛出异常的拟合会以 ``status="failed"`` 记录，异常文本放在 ``error`` 中；运行完成但未满足收敛标准的拟合会以 ``status="not_converged"`` 记录。两者的指标都为 ``NaN``。一个为失败点填入 0.5 的扫描，会把这些点绘制成表现处于随机水平的设计，从而把 "this design cannot find its hits" 与 "this fit failed" 混为一谈。

records.context: **Resuming.**  With ``progress_file``, each completed row is appended to a TSV immediately, so a killed sweep loses at most the point it was on.  Re-executing with ``resume=True`` (the default) reads the file and skips points whose ``run_key`` is already there.  The structured-data name is a digest of the parameter *values*, the replicate, the seed and the backend -- not the row number -- so extending or reordering the grid does not invalidate finished work.
records.label: spacr.power_model.scan_parameters#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Resuming.**  With ``progress_file``, each completed row is appended to a TSV immediately, so a killed sweep loses at most the point it was on.  Re-running with ``resume=True`` (the default) reads the file and skips points whose ``run_key`` is already there.  The key is a digest of the parameter *values*, the replicate, the seed and the backend -- not the row number -- so extending or reordering the grid does not invalidate finished work.
records.translation: **恢复运行。**设置了 ``progress_file`` 时，每个完成的行都会立即追加到一个 TSV 文件中，因此被终止的扫描最多只会丢失正在进行的那个点。以 ``resume=True``（默认）重新运行时，会读取该文件并跳过其 ``run_key`` 已存在的点。该键是参数*值*、重复编号、种子和后端的摘要——而不是行号——因此扩展网格或调整网格顺序都不会使已完成的工作失效。

records.source: So a project is found on disk (:func:`discover`, :func:`looks_like_project`) rather than read out of a registry, and an unrecorded one appears with everything the filesystem can answer — stage, size, files, last write — and with :attr:`ProjectSummary.known` False. records.translation: 因此，项目是在磁盘上被发现的（:func:`discover`、:func:`looks_like_project`），而不是从注册表中读取的；未被记录的项目会带着文件系统能够回答的所有信息出现——阶段、大小、文件、最近一次写入——并且 :attr:`ProjectSummary.known` 为 False。它不会被报告为 "0 stale"，因为那会被理解为*干净*。没有来源信息就没有可供比较的依据，因此过时状态为**未知**，而 :attr:`ProjectSummary.staleness_known` 就是表明这一点的标志。:meth:`ProjectSummary.staleness_note` 会将其用文字表述出来，供表格单元格使用。

records.label: spacr.report#4

records.source: Three rules govern what it does:
records.translation: 三条规则决定了它的行为：

records.context: **A missing section is stated, never omitted.** If segmentation QC was never executed, the report contains a "Segmentation QC" heading that says *not executed*. A reader cannot distinguish "clean" from "never checked" if unchecked things silently vanish, and that is exactly how a partial run gets forwarded as though it were complete.
records.label: spacr.report#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **A missing section is stated, never omitted.** If segmentation QC was never run, the report contains a "Segmentation QC" heading that says *not run*. A reader cannot distinguish "clean" from "never checked" if unchecked things silently vanish, and that is exactly how a partial run gets forwarded as though it were complete.
records.translation: **缺失的章节会被说明，而绝不会被省略。**如果从未运行过分割 QC，报告中会有一个 "Segmentation QC" 标题，并注明*未运行*。如果未检查的内容悄悄消失，读者就无法区分 "clean" 与 "never checked"，而部分完成的运行正是这样被当作已完成的运行转发出去的。

records.context: **Failure goes at the top.** :mod:`spacr.errors` stamps every artifact with a ``run_status`` recording how many items failed. If anything failed — or if nothing was stamped at all, so completeness is unknown — that is the first thing in the document, not an appendix entry.
records.label: spacr.report#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Failure goes at the top.** :mod:`spacr.errors` stamps every artifact with a ``run_status`` recording how many items failed. If anything failed — or if nothing was stamped at all, so completeness is unknown — that is the first thing in the document, not an appendix entry.
records.translation: **故障放在最前面。**:mod:`spacr.errors` 会给每个产物加上一个 ``run_status`` 标记，记录有多少个项目失败。如果有任何内容失败——或者根本没有加盖任何标记，因而完整性未知——这就是文档中的第一项内容，而不是附录中的一个条目。

records.context: spaCR depends on matplotlib and on nothing that converts HTML to PDF, and this module will not add such a dependency for one feature. The PDF is therefore a **monospace transcription** of the same content — the same sections, the same tables, the same "not run" statements — plus one page per embedded figure. Compared with the HTML it loses colour emphasis, table borders, collapsible detail blocks and clickable contents, and long cells are truncated to the page width. Send the HTML when the recipient can open one.

The PDF is therefore a **monospace transcription** of the same content — the same sections, the same tables, the same "not run" statements — plus one page per embedded figure. Compared with the HTML it loses colour emphasis, table borders, collapsible detail blocks and clickable contents, and long cells are truncated to the page width. Send the HTML when the recipient can open one.
records.translation: spaCR 依赖于 matplotlib，而不依赖于任何将 HTML 转换为 PDF 的工具，本模块也不会为了一项功能而添加这样的依赖。因此，PDF 是相同内容的**等宽字体转录**——相同的章节、相同的表格、相同的 "not run" 声明——外加每张嵌入图片各占一页。与 HTML 相比，它失去了颜色强调、表格边框、可折叠的详细信息区块以及可点击的目录，较长的单元格也会被截断为页面宽度。当接收者能够打开 HTML 时，请发送 HTML。

records.source: Powers the Home-screen insights dashboard: ``total_runs`` (all manifests seen), ``mask_runs`` / ``measure_runs`` / ``classify_runs`` (per-app tallies), and ``models_recorded`` (distinct model hashes ever recorded, across runs of every app — not only mask runs). records.translation: 为主界面的洞察仪表板提供数据：``total_runs``（看到的所有清单）、``mask_runs`` / ``measure_runs`` / ``classify_runs``（按应用统计的数量），以及 ``models_recorded``（在所有应用的运行中曾记录过的不同模型哈希——而不仅限于 mask 运行）。当尚不存在运行日志时返回零。

records.context: Counting is incremental: the totals and the names of the folders already counted are persisted in ``.journal_totals.json`` in the processing-session root, so each call parses only the manifests it has not seen. A folder that has since been deleted cannot be subtracted, so that case falls back to a full recount. A manifest that cannot be parsed is left out of the totals with a logged warning.
records.label: spacr.run_journal.journal_totals#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Counting is incremental: the totals and the names of the folders already counted are persisted in ``.journal_totals.json`` in the runs root, so each call parses only the manifests it has not seen. A folder that has since been deleted cannot be subtracted, so that case falls back to a full recount. A manifest that cannot be parsed is left out of the totals with a logged warning.
records.translation: 计数是增量进行的：总数以及已计数文件夹的名称会持久化保存在运行根目录的 ``.journal_totals.json`` 中，因此每次调用只解析尚未见过的清单。此后已被删除的文件夹无法被减去，因此这种情况会回退为完整的重新计数。无法解析的清单会被排除在总数之外，并记录一条警告。
